arguments.question: Across ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, assess material 21/63-session geopolitical and trade-policy transmission channels using available primary policy sources: semiconductor/export-control and China-related supply/demand channels, cross-border digital-regulatory exposure, and any documented effective dates. Separate dated facts from conditional implications; do not forecast policy or quantify unreported company exposure. Stop after available BIS/primary-policy material.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether policy/geopolitical dependencies could overturn or materially qualify differentiated company and QQQ theses, especially semiconductor-linked exposures.
